text: EAST at 22-25 is second-hand (#124). The exact free-alphabet test of 0119 and 0208, on the 20 letters Sanborn published himself, with up to two slips.
20 cells (length, form, slips) fit only once EAST is set aside; at no slip B11, B16, B22, B24, B25, V25, V26.

A plant fits its own cell but so do some of its shuffles: the count cannot pick it out (0 of 6). The open cells need an English decider.
